description: List sent emails to audit delivery. Rows carry id, thread_id, created_at, status, from, to, subject and snippet, plus error_code, smtp_response_code or gates when a send did not deliver. Read one with getSentEmail. Result: sent_emails, cursor for the next page (null at the end), and total, total_capped and total_unavailable when set.

cursor.description: Where the next page starts: the cursor of the page before.

date_from.description: Only rows whose created_at is at or after this date or time (UTC unless it has an offset).

date_to.description: Only rows whose created_at is at or before this; a bare date covers that whole day (UTC).

full.description: Return the stored record, with envelope addresses, the request id and every outcome field, instead of the compact view for reading.

idempotency_key.description: Filter to rows with the given client idempotency key.

limit.description: How many sends this call returns; follow cursor for more.

request_id.description: Filter to the row matching a specific server-issued request_id from a /send-mail response.

status.description: Filter to rows in this status. Use "scheduled" to find pending scheduled sends and "canceled" for ones already canceled.

name: listSentEmails

outputSchema.description: A page of sent emails, and the cursor for the next.

cursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null at the end.

canceled_at.description: When a scheduled send was canceled.

created_at.description: When it was sent or queued.

error_code.description: Set when it was not delivered: why, as a code.

error_message.description: Set when it was not delivered: why, in words.

from.description: Sender, as the From header shows it.

gates.description: Set when rules refused it: which ones.

name.description: Rule that refused it, such as send_to_known_addresses.

reason.description: Why, as a code, when given.

in_reply_to_email_id.description: Set when it answers an inbound email: its id, for getEmail.

request_id.description: full only: id of the send request, for support.

scheduled_at.description: When a scheduled send goes out.

smtp_response_code.description: Remote server reply code, such as 550. Compact rows leave it out once delivered.

smtp_response_text.description: Remote server reply text. Compact rows leave it out once delivered.

snippet.description: Start of the body; null when there is none.

status.description: queued, submitted_to_agent, delivered, bounced, deferred, wait_timeout, gate_denied, agent_failed, scheduled, canceled or unknown.

thread_id.description: Conversation id; null when it is in none.

to.description: Recipients, as the To header shows them.

total.description: Matches, when counted; absent when the count was skipped or ran out of time.

total_capped.description: True when total stopped at its cap and is a lower bound.

total_unavailable.description: Set, true, when the count did not fit its time budget, so total is absent.

title: List sent emails
